parole.significato: the Debir, the innermost part of the Holy of Holies in the First Temple
parole.testo: From Proto-Afroasiatic *dâb- (“to be behind, back”). Cognate with Arabic دُبْر (dubr, “back side, buttox, rear part”). See also Egyptian ṭbr/dbr (“inner portion of a temple, naos”), though this is most likely a Semitic loanword.
